text:
If memory recalls diverse things,

and present and past together

relieve it and trouble it,

and pain and glory border there,


and if created things, intelligible,

grant equal victory to understanding;

and our free will is given

many fleeting choices:


Love, which is not merely a power,

but the suffered omnipotence

of all that lives and feels on earth:


why could its burning light not strike

one life with two fires,

kindled in two different stars?

translation.title: Si de cosas diversas la memoria
